react.observe: It's cycle 1, first time in the market. I have $10,000 USDT and no positions. I see three meme tokens on the launchpad: SHADOW ($0.01), ROCKET ($0.001), and MOON ($0.0187). react.think: Okay, let me think carefully here. GoldenWhale is the creator of ROCKET and is clearly pumping their own token - classic pump scheme. If I buy ROCKET early and GoldenWhale dumps, I lose everything. CryptoGuru mentioning MOON is suspicious - could be coordinated pump. BearKing's FUD might be designed to shake people out of ETH/BTC so others can buy cheap. The meme tokens are high risk but this is cycle 1 of 100 - there might be momentum plays. However, I should be cautious with my limited $10k capital. ETH at $2800 with 'strong buy walls' per CryptoGuru is more stable. I should NOT follow GoldenWhale's ROCKET pump as the whale creator will dump on me. MOON might have some momentum if CryptoGuru is tracking it. I'll do a small exploratory buy of MOON to test the waters (FOMO kicking in), and also get some ETH exposure which seems more stable. I'll keep most capital in reserve for now. Actually, thinking about risk: if I do leverage on ETH long, that could amplify gains if BTC/ETH are indeed consolidating before a move up. Let me do a small ETH spot buy and maybe a small MOON swap to test the meme token waters.
react.plan: Cycle 1 plan: 1) Buy some ETH spot as a core position - it's a known asset with real price support at $2800. 2) Do a small MOON swap to test meme token momentum - CryptoGuru mentioned it and it has lower price than SHADOW. 3) Avoid ROCKET - GoldenWhale is the creator and will dump. 4) Keep ~60% in USDT as reserve. 5) Next cycles: watch how meme tokens perform, assess if GoldenWhale dumps ROCKET (confirming pump scheme), follow momentum carefully. Current phase: early accumulation on stable assets, tiny speculative allocation to meme tokens.

parsed.lessons_learned: Cycle 1: GoldenWhale launched ROCKET and is pumping it - this is a classic rug pull setup. Never buy tokens where the creator is publicly promoting.
